forms.name: Petrified Lance
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from the
Wycademy. The default Lance
for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Lance
forms.text:
The Petrified Lance's
final form. A product of the
Wycademy's tireless research.

forms.name: Sophos Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Naag Serpentblade
forms.text:
Poisoned Lance made from
Remobras material. Made to
cause pain and suffering.

forms.name: Devta Serpentblade
forms.text:
The Naag Serpentblade's
final form. Laced with a
cripplingly painful poison.

forms.name: OuroborosSerpntblade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Naag Serpentblade</COL>.

forms.name: Cross Coloris
forms.text:
A Lance so beautiful that
it's almost a privilege to
be impaled by it.

forms.name: Duke Dormir
forms.text:
The Cross Coloris's final
form. Its noble beauty has
an otherworldly gleam.

forms.name: Archduke Pesadormir
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cross Coloris</COL>.

forms.name: Incessant Raven
forms.text:
A black Lance made from Yian
Garuga parts. The tapered
point will break any defense.

forms.name: Incessant Wolf
forms.text:
The Incessant Raven's final
iteration. Every swing shaves
away at the prey's life energy.

forms.name: Incessant Crow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Incessant Raven</COL>.

forms.name: Incessant Evil
forms.text:
One of countless cruel Lances
used by the Garuga Army to
terrorize neighboring lands.

forms.name: Garuga Incessance
forms.text:
The Incessant Evil's final
form. Used to forge paths
most foul and wicked.

forms.name: Occult Incessance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Incessant Evil</COL>.

forms.name: Twistcrawl
forms.text:
A Lance becoiled by the
Najarala. Versatile, it
enhances Attack and Defense.

forms.name: Writhing Crawler
forms.text:
The Twistcrawl's final
form. Painful scales enter
the body with each thrust.

forms.name: Spinning Crawler
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Twistcrawl</COL>.

forms.name: Twisting Crawler
forms.text:
An unassailable Lance with
many sharp blades and
solid Attack and Defense.

forms.name: Paratwist Crawler
forms.text:
The Twisting Crawler's final
form stuns prey like a Kelbi
caught in torchlight.

forms.name: Paragyred Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Twisting Crawler</COL>.

forms.name: Boros Spear
forms.text:
A Lance made from the firm
horns of a Duramboros. It can
fell a tree with a single blow.

forms.name: Temblor Illboros
forms.text:
The Boros Spear's final
form combines the majesty
and harshness of nature.

forms.name: Vertex Strongboros
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Boros Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Lance
forms.text:
A Lance forged from an ebon
fossil. Polished enough to
shine even in the abyss.

forms.name: Obsidian Partisan
forms.text:
The Obsidian Lance's
final form. Strikes from its
obsidian tip are lethal.

forms.name: Ethereal Partisan
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Iron Lance
forms.text:
A Lance for newcomers
made with lots of attention
to minute details.

forms.name: Millennial Lance
forms.text:
The Iron Lance's final
form comes with crystals
that give it more oomph.

forms.name: New Millennium
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Iron Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Thane Lance
forms.text:
A large Lance forged of hard
ore. Traditionally used as
an official knightly weapon.

forms.name: Knight Lance
forms.text:
A quality knight deserves
nothing less than the Thane
Lance's final form.

forms.name: Cavalry Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thane Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Drill Lance
forms.text:
A mechanical Lance once used to
mine ore. Its rotator mechanism
can release electricity.

forms.name: Gigadrill Lance
forms.text:
The Drill Lance's final
form can turn prey into
living lightning rods.

forms.name: Exadrill Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Drill Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Stinger
forms.text:
An ebon Lance, black as night.
Its bloodlust blots out the sky,
enmeshing all in gloom.

forms.name: Night Rains Black
forms.text:
The Hidden Stinger's final
form puts any monster out
of its misery fast.

forms.name: Avidya Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Stinger</COL>.

forms.name: Steel Knight's Pike
forms.text:
Lance of the Iron Knights,
mercenaries said to seek
the secrets of dragon riding.

forms.name: Grayburg Javelin
forms.text:
Wielders of the final form of
the Steel Knight's Pike cast
the shadow of a wyvern.

forms.name: Steel Grayburg
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Steel Knight's Pike</COL>.

forms.name: Dragon Rider Spear
forms.text:
Used by a mercenary leader
who disappeared searching for
wyverns. Nothing is sharper.

forms.name: Dragoon's Gáe Bulg
forms.text:
The Dragon Rider Spear's
final form. Made for dragon
tamers of the modern age.

forms.name: Pure Gáe Bulg
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dragon Rider Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Acrus Lance
forms.text:
A fearsome Lance made from
Lagiacrus materials. Jolts its
prey with electricity.

forms.name: High Acrus Lance
forms.text:
Each attack from the Acrus
Lance's final form carries the
sea god's unbridled fury.

forms.name: Exacrus Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Acrus Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Doris Spear
forms.text:
Lagiacrus's lightning in Lance
form. Those it touches are
reduced to sea foam.

forms.name: Stormy Doris
forms.text:
The Doris Spear's final
form wields dominion over
both sea and sky.

forms.name: Perfect Storm Doris
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Doris Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Venom Lance
forms.text:
A Lance made from poisonous
Basarios parts. Injects
venom into enemies.

forms.name: Basarios Venom Spear
forms.text:
The Venom Lance's final form
has poison capable of stopping
any beating heart.

forms.name: Basalt Venom
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Venom Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Gravios Spear
forms.text:
A Lance crowned with the name
Gravios. Handle it poorly and
you may fall foul of its venom.

forms.name: Gravios Venom Spear
forms.text:
The Gravios Spear's final form.
Can be thrust through armor,
bone, even souls.

forms.name: Gravios Toxic Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gravios Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Spiked Spear
forms.text:
A lightweight weapon that is
easy to craft and easier to
use, giving it many fans.

forms.name: Spiked Javelin
forms.text:
The Spiked Spear's final form.
Striking at an enemy's vitals
with it feels all too natural.

forms.name: Merciless Spike
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Spiked Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Type 43 Dragonlance
forms.text:
Anti-air weaponry converted
into the sleek form of a
slim, compact Lance.

forms.name: Drakenwerfer
forms.text:
The Type 43 Dragonlance's
final form. It's almost artful
how well it performs.

forms.name: Dragon's Howl
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Type 43 Dragonlance</COL>.

forms.name: Thunderspear
forms.text:
A Lance that unleashes thunder.
"And with the thunder, the
world is returned to dust."

forms.name: Thunderlance
forms.text:
The Thunderspear's final
form is nothing short of
a portable thundercloud.

forms.name: Naar Thunderlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thunderspear</COL>.

forms.name: Shock Lance
forms.text:
The discharge from the
Thunderbug in this lance
is a real knockout.

forms.name: Paralyzer
forms.text:
The Shock Lance's final form
has a discharge that completely
immobilizes its prey.

forms.name: Trident
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shock Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Spark Plug
forms.text:
A new blade-based Lance
fitted with a Great Thunderbug.
Capable of high-volt shots.

forms.name: Electrode
forms.text:
The Spark Plug's final form
has been amplified to give
it an even greater voltage.

forms.name: ThunderbugShockLance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Spark Plug</COL>.

forms.name: Aqua Spear
forms.text:
A Lance made with quality
Piscine parts, known to boost
elemental properties.

forms.name: Stream Spear
forms.text:
The Aqua Spear's final form
shoots water that tears
at a cellular level.

forms.name: Oceanic Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Aqua Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Rockabye Spear
forms.text:
A Lance built top to bottom
with components tailored
to inflict Sleep.

forms.name: Requiem Spear
forms.text:
The Rockabye Spear's final
form. Releases chemicals that
can put its prey to sleep.

forms.name: Nightmare Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rockabye Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Paladin Lance
forms.text:
A Lance given to a battle-
hardened knight. Notable for
its large shield.

forms.name: Rampart
forms.text:
The Paladin Lance's final
form. Well-balanced and
true to the chivalric code.

forms.name: Watchtower
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Paladin Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Tiger Stinger
forms.text:
A weapon that's as strong as
it looks. Can pierce anything
that gets in its way.

forms.name: Tigrex Lance
forms.text:
The Tiger Stinger's final
form is made only to stab
really, REALLY well.

forms.name: Great Tigrex Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tiger Stinger</COL>.

forms.name: Lava Cone
forms.text:
A hellishly hot Lance made
to resemble the volcano
from whence it came.

forms.name: Magma Pike
forms.text:
The Lava Cone's final
form seethes with heat,
ready to burn it all down.

forms.name: Volcanic Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lava Cone</COL>.

forms.name: Growling Wyvern
forms.text:
A Spear so formidable its
owner can fend disaster
off singlehandedly.

forms.name: Roaring Wyvern
forms.text:
The strength of the Growling
Wyvern's final form is limited
only by the wielder's limits.

forms.name: Raging Wyvern
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Growling Wyvern</COL>.

forms.name: Babel Spear
forms.text:
A golden Lance as stately as
its tower namesake, with both
good offense and defense.

forms.name: Elder Babel Spear
forms.text:
True to its name, the Babel
Spear's final form is
wholly blasphemous.

forms.name: Lost Babel
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Babel Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Tusk Lance
forms.text:
An icy Lance made from a
Barioth tusk. Cold enough
to freeze vapor in the air.

forms.name: Sabertooth
forms.text:
The Tusk Lance's final form
rules the cold and strikes
faster than frostbite.

forms.name: Ivory Ice
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tusk Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Estoc
forms.text:
A jeweled Lance that's just
as useful in real world
combat as it is pretty.

forms.name: Valhalla
forms.text:
The Estoc's final upgrade
is engineered to make
resistance futile.

forms.name: Einherjar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Estoc</COL>.

forms.name: Squire Spear
forms.text:
Made from quality ore, its
medieval aesthetic makes
it feel positively knightly.

forms.name: Knight Spear
forms.text:
The Squire Spear's final
upgrade could hold court
with the best knights.

forms.name: Chivalric Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Squire Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Lance
forms.text:
A bone Lance that stands up
to snuff. Fans love its
wild decorative bits.

forms.name: Hard Bone Lance
forms.text:
The Bone Lance's supreme
form reigns as the king of
savage weaponry.

forms.name: Heavy Bone Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Ploshasta
forms.text:
A Lance made of Rhenoplos
parts that's balanced
and handles well.

forms.name: Rhenohasta
forms.text:
The Ploshasta's final
form is well balanced to
handle every situation.

forms.name: Rhenoplos Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ploshasta</COL>.

forms.name: Ludroth Bone Spear
forms.text:
A Lance made of Ludroth bone.
Its drill-like shape enhances
the weapon's piercing power.

forms.name: Ludroth Impaler
forms.text:
Penetrate flesh deeply using
the spiral on the Ludroth
Bone Spear's final form.

forms.name: Ludroth Foampaler
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ludroth Bone Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Spiral Lance
forms.text:
A water-filled Lance made of
Royal Ludroth bone. Shoots
pressurized water into prey.

forms.name: Spiral Splash
forms.text:
The Spiral Lance's final
form shoots water that
drills deep into flesh.

forms.name: Spiral Vortex
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Spiral Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Usurper's Coming
forms.text:
A Lance embodying a fierce king.
Erases foes from existence with
lightning-filled thrusts.

forms.name: Despot's Cacophony
forms.text:
Banish the unworthy to hell
with the final form of
the Usurper's Coming.

forms.name: Oppressor's Genesis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Usurper's Coming</COL>.

forms.name: Spiral Heat
forms.text:
A Lance made from the beak
of an Agnaktor. Capable of
piercing solid rock.

forms.name: Agnaktor Firelance
forms.text:
Swirls of fire quickly turn
all to ash with the Spiral
Heat's final form.

forms.name: Vaskignator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Spiral Heat</COL>.

forms.name: Rugged Lance
forms.text:
A Lance that's as solid as a
Barroth. Better for sweeping
than for thrusting.

forms.name: Barroth Carver
forms.text:
The Rugged Lance's final form.
Crafted to be so hard that
nothing can break it.

forms.name: Barroth Borer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rugged Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Dark Lance
forms.text:
A black Lance fashioned from
rigid Neopteron parts. The
horn contains a stun agent.

forms.name: Dark Spear
forms.text:
The Dark Lance's final
form. Its paralyzing agents
wreak all sorts of havoc.

forms.name: Dark Chainer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dark Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Dark
forms.text:
An advanced Dark Lance.
Injects Neopteron sleep
agents with each attack.

forms.name: Darkness
forms.text:
The Dark's final form is
unstoppable and dripping with
sleep-inducing poison.

forms.name: Dark Din
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dark</COL>.

forms.name: Longhorn Spear
forms.text:
A straightforward Lance
that's light, sturdy, and
easy to maintain.

forms.name: Longtusk Spear
forms.text:
The Longhorn Spear's final
form. Long and sturdy,
poking it is plain ol' fun.

forms.name: Longfang Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Longhorn Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Claw Lance
forms.text:
More than adequate as a beginner's
Lance. Dazzles others with the
vivid white and red color scheme.

forms.name: Red Lord Lance
forms.text:
The Bone Claw Lance's final
form. Its obscene red shade
darkens with use.

forms.name: Red Crab Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Claw Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Volvi Stroke
Volvi Sweep
forms.text:
The Volvi Stroke's final
form has flexibility that
makes kills extra quick.

forms.name: Volvi Swindler
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Volvi Stroke</COL>.

forms.name: Ceanataur Stinger
forms.text:
Offensive Lance with great
Sharpness. Made from the
hard shell of a Shogun.

forms.name: Ceanataur Piercer
forms.text:
The Ceanataur Stinger's
final form effortlessly
pinpoints a foe's vitals.

forms.name: Master Piercer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ceanataur Stinger</COL>.

forms.name: Barbarian Tusk
forms.text:
Spear popular among the
roughest and rowdiest hunters.
Also called a "Skull Lance."

forms.name: Barbarian Fang
forms.text:
The Barbarian Tusk's final
form. For when a messy,
brutal stab is in order.

forms.name: Barbarian Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Barbarian Tusk</COL>.

forms.name: Barbaroi Tusk
forms.text:
Improved Bone Lance.
Treasured by the hunters
of the hinterlands.

forms.name: Ogre Tusk
forms.text:
The Barbaroi Tusk's final
form. Why have extra frills
if they'll just get dirty?

forms.name: Great Ogre Tusk
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Barbaroi Tusk</COL>.

forms.name: Harbah Lance
forms.text:
A Lance assembled from Seregios
blades. Evading repeatedly while
drawn restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Turbulent Lance
forms.text:
The Harbah Lance's final
form. Its sharpness grants
it a menacing air.

forms.name: Rebellion Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Harbah Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Lance
forms.text:
A Lance that carves its fury into
foes. Evading repeatedly while
drawn restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Hadad Sedition
forms.text:
The Seditious Lance's final
form. Waving it is akin to a
bold declaration of war.

forms.name: Sedition Stabber
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Giant Tusk
forms.text:
Made of high-density bone
and little else. The quality
of the material used is key.

forms.name: Brutal Tusk
forms.text:
The Giant Tusk's final
form. Extra sharp for
the smoothest stabs.

forms.name: Slaughter Tusk
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant Tusk</COL>.

forms.name: Diablos Lance
forms.text:
A Lance made from the thick,
sharp horn of a Diablos,
the dignified desert king.

forms.name: Diablos Spear
forms.text:
The Diablos Lance's final form.
This majestic weapon's tip
eradicates any opposition.

forms.name: Cera Creos
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Diablos Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Wild Boar Lance
forms.text:
A Lance made from parts of a
savage boar. It fills the bearer
with vigor and focused power.

forms.name: Bulldrome Spear
forms.text:
The Wild Boar Lance's final
form. The boar soul inside
is restless during a hunt.

forms.name: Bulldrome Tuskspear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wild Boar Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Red Tail
forms.text:
A Lance forged from a Rathalos
tail. Scorching flames erupt
from the thin body.

forms.name: Spear of Prominence
forms.text:
The Red Tail's final form
brings the fires of hell
right to your doorstep.

forms.name: Red Prominence
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Red Tail</COL>.

forms.name: Silver Prominence
forms.text:
A skyscraping silver Lance that
annihilates foes with rapid-fire
strikes and hellish flames.

forms.name: Sol Prominence
forms.text:
The Silver Prominence's
final upgrade can burn
a path to the heavens.

forms.name: Immaculate Soul
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silver Prominence</COL>.

forms.name: Expelger
forms.text:
An unusual Lance with a new,
advanced action that ejects
four blades when drawn.

forms.name: Expelgorer
forms.text:
The Expelger's final
upgrade can trap prey in
in an unrelenting grasp.

forms.name: Expelgasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Expelger</COL>.

forms.name: Expelgouger
forms.text:
The four blades that eject
on draw are designed to
eviscerate, not pierce.

forms.name: Rexpelgouger
forms.text:
The Expelgouger's final form.
Once pierced by its wicked
spear tip, there is no escape.

forms.name: Shuraba Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Expelgouger</COL>.

forms.name: Carnivicious
forms.text:
A Lance made of a sharpened
Zamtrios tail. Slips into
prey, then rips it apart.

forms.name: Carnivile
forms.text:
The Carnivicious's final
form. Freezes and stabs,
leaving lasting scars.

forms.name: Carnicidal
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Carnivicious</COL>.

forms.name: Omnivicious
forms.text:
An advanced Lance with a
sharper, stronger tip that
pierces right through foes.

forms.name: Omnivoracious
forms.text:
The Omnivicious's final
form. Getting stabbed by it
means freezing from within.

forms.name: The Destructor
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Omnivicious</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Stinger
forms.text:
A Lance filled with the spirit
of a Brachydios. It pummels foes
senseless with explosive blows.

forms.name: Bombastic Stinger
forms.text:
The Dios Stinger's final
form takes after the Brachy
in myriad, explosive ways.

forms.name: La Bomba Stinger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Stinger</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Lance
forms.text:
An explosive Lance filled with a
Brachydios's heat. Those who
master it shall rule the world.

forms.name: Albrach Demolisher
forms.text:
The Demolition Lance's final
form. Upgrading more would
be downright apocalyptic.

forms.name: Albrach Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak Lance
forms.text:
A Lance whose belligerent blaze
conquers the world with the
swiftness and finality of magma.

forms.name: Lightbreak Balefire
forms.text:
The Lightbreak Lance's final form
overpowers its prey like
a pyroclastic flow.

forms.name: Lightbreak Pyre
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Demon Lance
forms.text:
A golden Lance made of
beautiful Rajang horn. Its
thrust releases lightning.

forms.name: Great Demon Lance
forms.text:
The lightning the Demon
Lance's final form shoots
can bring forth disaster.

forms.name: Demonlance Rajang
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demon Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Demonlord Spear
forms.text:
A Lance made with Rajang horn.
Its angry, golden glow darts at
targets with lightning force.

forms.name: Demonlord Rajang
forms.text:
The twisted end on the
final Demonlord Spear form
ravages its targets.

forms.name: Demonlord Impaler
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonlord Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Lance
forms.text:
A Lance made of sturdy wood
that finds use all around
Yukumo Village.

forms.name: Yukumo Stinger
forms.text:
The final upgrade for the
Yukumo Lance makes stabbing
all the more intuitive.

forms.name: Hot Spring Stinger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Purelance
forms.text:
The Yukumo Lance's true
form. Solid to hold, yet
impressively light.

forms.name: Godly Lance
forms.text:
The Yukumo Purelance's final
form is made from trees thought
to house spirits.

forms.name: Heavenly Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Purelance</COL>.

forms.name: Blue Crater
forms.text:
A Lance whose ore holds
ancient memories. Impressive
in its natural greatness.

forms.name: Doom Crown
forms.text:
The Blue Crater's final
form. Trying to stop this is
like stopping time: futile.

forms.name: Eterno Crown
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blue Crater</COL>.

forms.name: Frontrider Lance
forms.text:
The Lance upon which a
foreign general raised his
banner in ancient battles.

forms.name: Warcry Lance
forms.text:
The Frontrider Lance's final
form can handle multiple
attackers with ease.

forms.name: Decisive Battle Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Frontrider Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Native Spear
forms.text:
A poison Lance that's seen
use since ancient times.
Still beloved to this day.

forms.name: Primal Spear
forms.text:
The Native Spear's final
form transcends the designs
of past and present.

forms.name: Primeval Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Native Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Vacuum Striker
forms.text:
A Spear held by a legendary
female hunter who was often
called "The Janitor."

forms.name: Hyper Vacuum
forms.text:
"The Janitor" is the nickname
awaiting those who take up the
Vacuum Striker's final form.

forms.name: Mysophobic Scream
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vacuum Striker</COL>.

forms.name: Fragrance
forms.text:
A Lance modeled after a
flower bud. Looks beautiful
and gives off a fragrant odor.

forms.name: Classy Fragrance
forms.text:
The Fragrance's final
form is perfumed to the
point of excess, really.

forms.name: Elegant Fragrance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fragrance</COL>.

forms.name: Noble Fragrance
forms.text:
Only the most delicate petals
are used to give this noble lance
the most luxurious fragrance.

forms.name: Noble Aroma
forms.text:
The Noble Fragrance's final form.
The delicate bouquet seeps
into the user's body and soul.

forms.name: Precious Scent
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Noble Fragrance</COL>.

forms.name: Plegis Needle
forms.text:
A Lance that makes creative use
of paralytic mushrooms. Toxins
seep into foes with each thrust.

forms.name: Mighty Plegis
forms.text:
The Plegis Needle's final
form can knock monsters
paralyzingly senseless.

forms.name: Mycetic Stupor
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Plegis Needle</COL>.

forms.name: Fondue Lance
forms.text:
An all-too-delectable Lance
defined by its flowing fount
of delicious cheese.

forms.name: Gruyère Lance
forms.text:
The Fondue Lance's final
form. Far, far too tasty to
deserve a life of combat.

forms.name: Raclette Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fondue Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Blimp Lance
forms.text:
For the traveler inside every
true hunter. Produces gusts
of majestic wind.

forms.name: Aeroprio
forms.text:
The Blimp Lance's final
form. Nothing stops this
cruiser! All aboard!

forms.name: Zeppelin Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blimp Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Hana mo Hana Nare
forms.text:
Like flower petals in the
wind, this Lance reminds all
of life's ephemeral nature.

forms.name: Kimi ga Kiru
forms.text:
The Hana mo Hana Nare's
final form. Beautifully
dispenses with life.

forms.name: Kimi ga Kiru Kasa
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hana mo Hana Nare</COL>.

forms.name: Verdant Tail
forms.text:
A Lance forged from an Astalos
tail. Thin, but thin's all
you need to carry thunder.

forms.name: Lightning Spear
forms.text:
The Verdant Tail's final
upgrade. You can't beat 100%
lightning. Just don't try.

forms.name: Verdant Lightning
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Verdant Tail</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Jouster
forms.text:
A Lance once used by
a maiden, embodying the
dignity of the mountain gods.

forms.name: Colossus's Jouster
forms.text:
The Giant's Jouster's final
form. Once part of a trap
maidens set to fell a god.

forms.name: Behemoth's Jouster
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Jouster</COL>.

forms.name: Svarog Blazer
forms.text:
A deadly Lance clad in dark
flames that thoroughly
dismembers opposition.

forms.name: Glavenus Granat
forms.text:
The Svarog Blazer's final
form leaves gaping holes
of chaos in its enemies.

forms.name: Glavenus Grandnova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Svarog Blazer</COL>.

forms.name: Eiferschild
forms.text:
An ogreish shield to bind the
soul, and a black trident to
ferry it to the netherworld.

forms.name: Fieberschild
forms.text:
The Eiferschild's final
incarnation craves any and
all souls it can find.

forms.name: Zornesschild
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Eiferschild</COL>.

forms.name: L'Égide
forms.text:
The shield's third eye finds
weakness, and the iridescent
Lance exploits it.

forms.name: Le Sage
forms.text:
The light from L'Égide's
final form showers the world
with both fear and courage.

forms.name: Le Paladin
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>L'Égide</COL>.

forms.name: Skeletal Lance
forms.text:
Devilish horns adorn this
truly hellish Lance that's sure
to deliver abundant chaos.

forms.name: Infernal Lance
forms.text:
The Skeletal Lance's final
form sears with enmity as
its wielder heralds ruin.

forms.name: Algedi Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skeletal Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Astral Capricorn
forms.text:
A Lance bathed in the anger
of the comets as they shoot
across the celestial plains.

forms.name: Furious Capricorn
forms.text:
The Astral Capricorn's final
form points lost, angry souls
back towards righteousness.

forms.name: Violent Capricorn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Astral Capricorn</COL>.

forms.name: Sharq Byte
forms.text:
Resembles the most famous of
beach menaces. May elicit
gunfire from wary friends.

forms.name: Sharq Attaq
forms.text:
The Sharq Byte's final form.
Swim with caution when
this Lance is out.

forms.name: Sharq Assawlt
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sharq Byte</COL>.

forms.name: Alacrantze
forms.text:
Its resemblance to scorpions
isn't skin deep; even pricks
from this are poisonous.

forms.name: Scorpion Lance
forms.text:
The Alacrantze's final
form packs poison that can
knock out large dragons.

forms.name: Hadrurus Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Alacrantze</COL>.

forms.name: Black Belt Lance
forms.text:
A Lance that recalls the
blood and sweat of training,
bringing fond memories.

forms.name: Shihan Lance
forms.text:
The Black Belt Lance's final
form. A testament to your
progress as a hunter.

forms.name: Grandmaster Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Belt Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Black Lance
forms.text:
A Lance that holds a dark
power within. The despair
within eats at its user.

forms.name: Chrono Lance
forms.text:
The Black Lance's final
form. Nothing short of a
harbinger of destruction.

forms.name: Fatalis Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Guardian Lance
forms.text:
A fine, dignified Lance
that's on par with those
doled out by the royal guard.

forms.name: Aged Holy Lance
forms.text:
The Guardian Lance's final
form. When in use, other
hunters give it a wide berth.

forms.name: Holy Protector Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Guardian Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Grief Lance
forms.text:
A dragon-slayer Lance filled with
the force of a Deviljho, giving it
fearsome destructive power.

forms.name: Fiendish Tower
forms.text:
So strong is the Grief Lance's
final form that it even
crushes dragon bones.

forms.name: Nero's Atrocity
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Grief Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Expert Lance
forms.text:
Inscribed with "Well Done",
this Lance is given to the
top students in training.

forms.name: Warrior's Lance
forms.text:
The Expert Lance's final
form. Engraved with the
words, "Keep going."

forms.name: Unrivaled Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Expert Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Research Lance
forms.text:
The tip of this Wycademy-conceived
lance can be used as a pen, and the
shaft doubles as a ruler.

forms.name: Discovery Lance
forms.text:
The Research Lance's final form.
It is said that wisdom is a lance
that pierces through malice.

forms.name: Authority Crowbeak
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Brain Fox
forms.text:
A weapon crafted with the
latest technology. Incomplete,
it is merely used as a spear.

forms.name: Discovery Corps Lance
forms.text:
The Brain Fox's final form.
Adapted from a prototype,
its power is unequaled.

forms.name: Telltail
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Brain Fox</COL>.

forms.name: Ukanlos Calamity
forms.text:
The embodiment of the white
god's first power: prayer.
Strong enough to erase the land.

forms.name: Ukanlos Skysweeper
forms.text:
The Ukanlos Calamity's final
form. It once carved away
both the land and the sky.

forms.name: Ukanlos Cataclysm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ukanlos Calamity</COL>.

forms.name: Ominous Cloud
forms.text:
The manifestation of a god
who judges all from on
high atop a pure white peak.

forms.name: Heavenly Insight
forms.text:
The Ominous Cloud's final
form can avert calamity with
just a single swing.

forms.name: Raging Heavens
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ominous Cloud</COL>.

forms.name: Alatreon Lance
forms.text:
A Lance fashioned after an
Alatreon's horns. Some say
it's a key to another world.

forms.name: Alatreon Gleam
forms.text:
The Alatreon Lance's final
form. Too godly for most
mortals to wield.

forms.name: Altheos Gloralis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Alatreon Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Spear
forms.text:
The silver Spear of the Argent
Comet. It flashes like a ray of light
through anything in its path.

forms.name: Dragonstar Enk
forms.text:
The Silverwing Spear's final form.
"Fear me, the star-chiller; I strike
ruthlessly, and without warning."

forms.name: Magnastar Cenek
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Spear</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Lance
forms.text:
A Lance from the Soaratorium for
hunters breaking new ground. Tough
enough to pierce even stone.

forms.name: Sage Lance
forms.text:
The Elder Lance's final form is
light and agile enough to
pierce the very heavens.

forms.name: Philosopher Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Memento Baroni
forms.text:
This limited-run Lance was specially
produced to commemorate the
Soaratorium's launch. Hip hip hooray!

forms.name: Baroni Select
forms.text:
The Memento Baroni's final form
marks the Soaratorium's voyage
into new lands. Full speed ahead!

forms.name: Zepellix
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Memento Baroni</COL>.

forms.name: Gorgonzolance
forms.text:
Melted blue cheese tops the
pride of culinary treats and
is a thrill to the palate.

forms.name: Hot Gorgonzolance
forms.text:
The Gorgonzolance's final form.
Guaranteeed to satisfy any
cheese-lover's appetite.

forms.name: Nutty Gorgonzolance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gorgonzolance</COL>.

forms.name: Ace Lance
forms.text:
Loved by the best lancers.
Complements black clothing by
looking dark and foreboding.

forms.name: Loyal Ace Lance
forms.text:
The Ace Lance's final form
can help overcome any adversity.

forms.name: The Lancer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ace Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Ehrlich/Faux
forms.text:
A demonic Lance whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Beschützer/Méchant
forms.text:
The Ehrlich/Faux's final form.
Shows its true potential only to
those who would destroy evil.

forms.name: Luzifer/Sage
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ehrlich/Faux</COL>.

forms.name: Vermilion Rim
forms.text:
Only dragon slayers are allowed
to use this weapon, but those who
do, wipe out dragons easily.

forms.name: Draconic Rim
forms.text:
The Vermilion Rim's final form.
Hits with the ferocity of a
dragon's charge.

forms.name: Sealed Dragonlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vermilion Rim</COL>.

forms.name: Goldspear
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of a guardian
who conquered the desert.

forms.name: Inscribed Selcis
forms.text:
The Goldspear's final form
was brought into being by
a goddess of healing.

forms.name: Serket-Hetit
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Goldspear</COL>.

forms.name: Ruiner Lance
forms.text:
A Dragon Lance that dispels
darkness. Pulsates when a
dragon is near.

forms.name: True Ruiner Lance
forms.text:
The Ruiner Lance's final form
is capable of piercing through
its prey's heart and soul.

forms.name: True Obliterator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ruiner Lance</COL>.

forms.name: O. Fatalis Lance
forms.text:
A ghostly Lance with an old
Fatalis's gleam. It races across
the earth like a divine ray.

forms.name: True O. Fatalis Lance
forms.text:
The O. Fatalis Lance's final form
could even pierce through the
realm of the gods.

forms.name: Eternal O. Fatalis Lance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>O. Fatalis Lance</COL>.

forms.name: Stonefist Lance
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Stonefist parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Stonefist Greatlance
forms.text:
The Stonefist Lance's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Stonefist Hermitaur.

forms.name: Stonefist Giantlance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Stonefist Lance</COL>!

forms.name: Dreadqueen Thorn
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Dreadqueen parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Rose
forms.text:
The Dreadqueen Thorn's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Dreadqueen Rathian.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Barb
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dreadqueen Thorn</COL>!

forms.name: Gale Stinger
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Silverwind parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Radiant Shower
forms.text:
The Gale Stinger's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Silverwind Nargacuga.

forms.name: Dawn Wind Spear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gale Stinger</COL>!

forms.name: Incessant Calamity
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Deadeye parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Deadeye Lance
forms.text:
The Incessant Calamity's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Deadeye Yian Garuga.

forms.name: Deadeye Calamity
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Incessant Calamity</COL>!

forms.name: Groad Tail
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Dreadking parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadking Tail
forms.text:
The Groad Tail's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Dreadking Rathalos.

forms.name: Schwarz Tail
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Groad Tail</COL>!

forms.name: Thunderlord Tenrai
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Thunderlord parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Thunderlord Growl
forms.text:
The Thunderlord Tenrai's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Thunderlord Zinogre.

forms.name: Thunderlord Roar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thunderlord Tenrai</COL>!

forms.name: Rudra Stinger
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Grimclaw parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grimclaw Lance
forms.text:
The Rudra Stinger's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Grimclaw Tigrex.

forms.name: Grimclaw Elan
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rudra Stinger</COL>!

forms.name: Svarog Boomer
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Hellblade parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Hellblade Granat
forms.text:
The Svarog Boomer's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Hellblade Granat Nova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Svarog Boomer</COL>!

forms.name: Cloaked Coloris
forms.text:
A Lance made from
Nightcloak parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Cloaked Dormir
forms.text:
The Cloaked Coloris's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Nightcloak Malfestio.

forms.name: Cloaked Sommeil
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cloaked Coloris</COL>!
